examples: 'agnizwAnasmAt praDamAni yajYAt (aTarva॰18.2.28). praDamAtIti lewi rUpam. praDamet vAtavad dUramAdadItetyarTaH.

'yaTA somyaM puruzaM ganDAreByo'BinadDAkzamAnIya taM tato'tijane visfjet sa yaTA tatra prAN vA…praDmAyIt' (CAM॰u॰6.14.1). vikroSet, SabdaM kuryAditi SaNkaraH.

–'divyO SaNKO pradaDmatuH' (gItA 1.14). prapUrayAmAsatuH.
'sapatnIM me parADama' (f॰10.145.2). parARudetyarTaH. parARudeti cATarvaRikAH paWanti.
'indradvizwAmapaDamanti mAyayA tvacamasiknIM BUmano divaspari' (f॰9.73.5). te'paDmAtA mahAtmanA.
'vi saptaraSmiraDamat tamAMsi' (f0 4.50.4). vyaDamat=vAta iva vyakirat. apAnudadityarTaH.
'tava BujabaladarpADmAyamAnasya vAmaH Sirasi caraRa eza nyasyate. vArayEnam' (veRI0 3.40). ADmAyamAnaH sPAyamAnaH.
'yogADamanavikrItaM yogadAnapratigraham' (mana0 8.165) ADamanaM banDakam. yoga iha cCalamuktaH.
'ADmAtastena hariRA na cakre SaNKarAq' (hari0 3.120.13). ADmAtaH pUritaH.
'yaccEtad bahuBirBerImADamadBiH SabdamuccArayadBi rmahAYSabda upalaByate' (mI0 SA0 BA0 1.1.6.17). ADamadBiH, pUrayadBiH, tAqayadBiH.
'aBi dasyuM vakureRA Damantoru jyotiScakraTurAryAya' (f0 1.117.21). aBiDamanta upaDamanto vAtenAgniM saMyojayantaH.
'yadImaha trito divyupaDmAteva Damati' (f0 5.9.5). ukto'rTaH. yadImaha=yad Im aha.
'(agniH) nAnupaDmAto nAnupajvalito jvalati' (Sa0 brA0 11.8.3.7). anupaDmAtaH=aDutaH, aDUtaH.
'tataH SaNKamupADmAsIt' (BA0 vi0 46.21, vi0 pu0 5.30.2). upADmAsIt apUrayat. luNi rUpam.
'pUtirajjurupaDmAnI pUtiM senAM kfRotvamUm' (aTarva0 8.8.2). upaDmAnI upari niHSvasatI. upari PUtkurvatI.
